exposure: Women not exposed to carboxymethylcellulose adhesion barrier
Women exposed to carboxymethylcellulose adhesion barrier
Carboxymethylcellulose adhesion barrier use during primary cesarean section
cohort: 114 women undergoing a first repeat cesarean section
finding: The study found that the use of a carboxymethylcellulose adhesion barrier during primary cesarean section is associated with a decrease in adhesions at the time of repeat CS, but this did not translate into significant clinical benefits.
mod_finding: Use of a carboxymethylcellulose adhesion barrier during primary cesarean section is associated with a decrease in adhesions at the time of repeat CS.
